summary.short_summary: Ameer Hashish presented a compelling overview of the business, highlighting its impressive growth from zero revenue to $2.3 million in the last year and a projected run rate of $3 million for 2026. With an operational model that relies on fixed and variable contracts averaging around $266,000, the company maintains a strong gross margin of 85%. Ameer emphasized the diverse client base exceeding 50 active clients, including major gaming companies and cashback platforms, achieved without marketing spend. He expressed openness to selling a majority stake to focus on growth and outlined plans to develop a self-service AI-driven platform for mobile publishers, aiming to scale revenue significantly. Additionally, the company manages valuable audience data with 170 million unique users, enhancing targeting capabilities for advertisers across social media platforms, thereby positioning itself strongly in the competitive market.
